note: On Campbell Bay of Lake Champlain in Swanton, with lakeshore cabins, a recreation room, boat rentals and gas at the pier. Nightly RV and tent sites sit back from the bay beside a larger block of seasonal sites. --Claude
summary: Operator site + parkwith.us engine: $32 tent / $45 with utilities confirmed (fees unchanged); 2027 season May 1-Sep 30 (was derived 05-01/10-01); online/phone/email booking, 14-night max; 30A + water, no sewer; pull-throughs; dump, showers, laundry, store. Bayview -> not waterfront recommended (RV rows ~100-150 m back behind road, store and shore cabins). Phone: engine/Google 802-999-7157 vs stored 802-868-0405. Mostly seasonal by imagery but nightly share passes; Google 4.7 (118).
